note: SEED. Step 15 has no detailed record in the final scope document. v2.5 states only that the verdict is pass / conditional / fail and that it gates the deep derivation before determinism classification. These rules test whether the deep-derivation inputs (steps 9-14) are complete enough to classify determinism and derive controls. Requires M42 confirmation.

rules.description: Fail where no workflow graph could be sequenced - determinism cannot be classified per step without one.
rules.reason: No workflow graph was derived. Steps 16-19 cannot classify determinism or derive controls without per-step nodes.

rules.description: Fail where the criticality class was not confirmed - the control rigour depends on it.
rules.reason: Criticality class is unconfirmed. Control derivation would proceed on an unvalidated rigour level.

rules.description: Conditional where no outcome assertions were declared - the solution would be unmonitorable.
rules.condition_text: No outcome assertions declared. Assertions must be added before build hand-off so the solution is monitorable against a system of record.

rules.description: Conditional where quality attribute scenarios carry no numeric response measure sourced from an existing business commitment.
rules.condition: any(scenario.response_measure_value is None for scenario in quality_attributes.scenarios)
rules.condition_text: One or more quality attribute scenarios lack a numeric response measure taken from an existing business commitment. Service levels must be sourced before component selection.

rules.description: Conditional where the ontology check found absent concepts - the derivation is reasoning over undefined terms.
rules.condition_text: Business objects are not defined as ontology concepts. Gap flags have been routed to the Ontology Council; concepts must be defined before the design is published.

rules.reason: Deep-derivation inputs are complete: a sequenced workflow graph, a confirmed criticality class and declared outcome assertions.
